# Lago Core Repository

> Lago is a billing platform available as fully managed Lago Cloud or open-source software on your own infrastructure. This repository contains the application source and a disposable local demo; running the demo does not require a self-hosted production deployment.

## Try Lago

- [Guided offline walkthrough](https://github.com/getlago/lago-plugin): Install the optional Lago plugin for Claude Code or Codex and ask `show me what Lago can do`. No Lago account, credentials, Docker, or application repository is needed. The calculation is illustrative and does not contact a Lago backend.
- [Real local billing demo](https://github.com/getlago/lago/tree/main/examples/agentic-ai-demo): Run `./examples/agentic-ai-demo/run.sh` from this checkout. It starts a disposable Docker deployment and verifies AI usage charges and event replay through the Lago API. It requires Docker, curl, and jq; clean up with `./examples/agentic-ai-demo/run.sh --cleanup`.
- [Lago Cloud](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/lago-cloud): Evaluate a fully managed production service without operating the Lago stack. Your application still integrates with Lago and connects payment collection.

## Build an integration

- [Developer documentation](https://getlago.com/docs/llms.txt): Billing concepts, task guides, SDKs, API reference, and agent entry points.
- [Ingest usage events](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/events/ingesting-usage): Send product events and check the event-store-specific deduplication key before retrying them.
- [Billable metric aggregation](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/billable-metrics/aggregation-types/overview): Choose how events become chargeable usage before applying plan prices and credits.
- [Complete OpenAPI specification](https://swagger.getlago.com/openapi.yaml): Check exact fields and endpoint behavior before implementing the REST API.
- [Lago CLI](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/lago-cli/overview): Configure and inspect a Cloud or self-hosted organization from the terminal. Live requests require an API key; a `test` mode is not an isolated sandbox.
- [Documentation MCP](https://getlago.com/docs/mcp): Search public documentation. [Product MCP](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/ai-agents/mcp-server) connects an assistant to live billing data with credentials.
- [AI gateway and router guides](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/ai-agents/agent-sdk/overview): Turn supported model usage into billable events; provider-cost availability varies by integration.

Applications should use a Lago SDK or the REST API at runtime. The plugin, CLI, and MCP servers help people and agents discover, configure, and inspect Lago; they are optional for the application.

## Work in this repository

- [README](https://github.com/getlago/lago#readme): Product overview, local demo, self-hosted setup, and project links.
- [Contributing guide](https://github.com/getlago/lago/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development and contribution workflow.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/getlago/lago/security): Report vulnerabilities privately.

Billing changes can affect invoices and payments. Verify the environment, organization, identifiers, currency, and expected amounts before live mutations. Keep API keys out of source control and prompts.
